We will investigate your dispute regarding the statute of limitations and provide a response in accordance with the FDCPA and Wisconsin state law. Since our records do not indicate any payments made on this account, the statute of limitations has not expired.

You have the right to dispute this account further, and we encourage you to provide any additional information or documentation that may support your claim. We will review this information and respond accordingly.
